summary: The candidate fixes BF16 scale allocation and TP-dependent shapes, but GPTQ GROUP scale dispatch does not forward load_full_w2, so desc_act w2 scales are still sharded in the real loader path.

tests.what_was_measured: Recorded base reproduced 4 failures and 1 pass for dtype, TP shape, and direct loader behavior.
Candidate's submitted focused regression passed 5 tests.

tests.command: independent Python assertion through FusedMoE._weight_loader_impl for GPTQ GROUP w2_scales, desc_act metadata, TP rank 1
tests.what_was_measured: Actual generic GROUP dispatch ignored load_full_w2, copied only the rank-1 half, and left half of the full destination uninitialized.

gpu_execution.evidence: One AMD Instinct MI350X gfx950 was visible, but the original failure requires CUDA Marlin and TP=2; no relevant GPU kernel was executed.

remaining_counterexamples: GPTQ GROUP w2_scales with desc_act=True and TP rank 1 still follows the sharded generic scale-loader branch because load_full_w2 is not forwarded there.
The candidate regression calls _load_w2 directly and therefore does not test the failing production dispatch through _weight_loader_impl.
remaining_limitations: Only one AMD gfx950 GPU was available; the reported two-rank NVIDIA RTX 4090 CUDA workload was unsupported.
The reported model weights were unavailable, so serving-path NaN logits were not reproduced.
No native source changed and no native rebuild was applicable.
